_schema: DatabaseSchema — Defines the Firestore document hierarchy. Root: knowvana → all platform collections live under it. (1) App reads this to know WHERE to store/read data, (2) Developers read this to understand the DB structure.

system_admins.description: Platform-level administrators. Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes (never plain text).

fields.passwordHash: string — bcrypt hash of the password (NEVER store plain text)
fields.createdAt: timestamp — When the admin was created

tenants.description: Organizations that subscribe to the platform. Each tenant is an isolated workspace.

fields.name: string — Organization name
fields.subscribedModules: array<string> — Module IDs this tenant has access to

tenant_users.description: Users who belong to a tenant. A user can belong to multiple tenants.

[tenantId].modules: array<string> — Module IDs this user can access within this tenant

system_logs.description: Persisted platform logs for audit trails and historical analysis. Written in batches to minimize Firestore costs.

fields.source: string — Component or module that generated the log
fields.user: string — Email of the user who triggered the action
fields.apiMethod: string — (API logs) HTTP method: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE
fields.apiStatusCode: number — (API logs) HTTP response status code
fields.apiResponseTimeMs: number — (API logs) Response time in milliseconds
fields._batchId: string — ID of the batch this log was flushed in

system_config.description: Platform-wide configuration stored in the database (logging settings, feature flags, etc.)

module_collections._description: Each module stores its data under the tenant's subcollection: platforms/knowvana/Tenants/{tenantId}/{ModuleCollection}
